query:
SELECT
            rp.file_id AS "file_id!",
            f.name AS "name!",
            rp.section_index AS "section_index!",
            rp.scroll_pct AS "scroll_pct!",
            rp.updated_at AS "updated_at!"
        FROM reading_progress rp
        JOIN files f ON f.id = rp.file_id
        WHERE rp.user_id = $1
        ORDER BY rp.updated_at DESC
        LIMIT 10
